title: Clear denominators of individual localized Tor classes
statement: Let A, B and C be commutative rings, φ : A → B a ring map, S a submonoid of B, and C an S-localization of B [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Let N be an A-module and j ≥ 0 [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Let f : B → C be the A-linear coefficient map given on elements by the localization structure map, using φ and (B → C) ∘ φ for scalar restriction. For every x in Tor^A_j(C,N), there are a unit u of C and a class y in Tor^A_j(B,N) such that Tor^A_j(mul_u,N)(x) = Tor^A_j(f,N)(y), where mul_u is the A-linear endomorphism of C induced by multiplication by u. There is no Tor-vanishing hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0B67, lemma-tor-amplitude-localization, localized derived-tensor homology identity in its proof; specialized to B in degree zero and expanded to clearing denominators of classes

proof.text: Choose a free A-resolution Q of N. Natural Tor symmetry and the resolution computation identify Tor_j(B,N) and Tor_j(C,N) with H_j(B tensor_A Q) and H_j(C tensor_A Q). Tensor-localization compatibility identifies C tensor_A Q with localization of B tensor_A Q. Represent x by a cycle in that localization. Clear its denominator to get a chain z over B; since dz becomes zero, multiply by another denominator to annihilate dz. The resulting chain is a cycle over B, defining y. The product s of the denominators belongs to S and its image u in C is a unit. Thus u times the original class is the image of y. Naturality of the resolution computation and of symmetry translates these two maps to the Tor maps in the statement. This is the elementwise surjectivity part of localization of homology; no vanishing or finiteness hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
theorem tor_localization_denominators
    (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (φ : A →+* B) [Algebra B C] (S : Submonoid B) [IsLocalization S C]
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} A) (j : ℕ)
    (f : (restrictScalars φ).obj (of B B) ⟶
      (restrictScalars ((algebraMap B C).comp φ)).obj (of C C))
    (hf : ∀ b : B, f b = algebraMap B C b)
    (x : (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) j).obj
      ((restrictScalars ((algebraMap B C).comp φ)).obj (of C C))).obj N)) :
    ∃ u : Cˣ, ∃ y : (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) j).obj
      ((restrictScalars φ).obj (of B B))).obj N),
      (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) j).map
        ((restrictScalars ((algebraMap B C).comp φ)).map
          (u.mulLeftLinearEquiv C C).toModuleIso.hom)).app N) x =
        (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) j).map f).app N) y
